closures.road: All roads into South Mumbai
closures.restriction: no-entry heavy vehicles and private buses
closures.details: Entry of heavy vehicles and private buses prohibited in South Mumbai on immersion days (2025: Aug 28, 31, Sep 1, 2 and 6). Exemptions listed: milk, vegetables, bakery, water tankers, fuel, ambulances, school buses, government vehicles.

closures.road: Greater Mumbai (excluding South Mumbai)
closures.restriction: no-entry heavy vehicles and private buses (time-bound)
closures.details: Heavy vehicles and private buses restricted 8:00 AM-11:00 AM and 5:00 PM-9:00 PM; during festival days these timings extended until midnight.
closures.timeWindow: 8:00 AM-11:00 AM and 5:00 PM-9:00 PM (extended to midnight on festival days)

closures.road: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel Road (Gol Deool to Prarthana Samaj Junction)
closures.details: All vehicular movement banned on SVP Road from Gol Deool to Prarthana Samaj Junction on Anant Chaturdashi.

closures.road: Padmashree Govardhan Bafna Chowk (Prarthana Samaj Junction) to Vinoli Junction
closures.details: No vehicles permitted on this stretch. Diversion: Raja Ram Mohan Roy Road, Bata Junction, Balaram Road, Navjeevan Junction, Tardeo Circle and Nana Chowk.

closures.road: Navjeevan Junction to M Powell Junction
closures.details: Traffic from Navjeevan Junction to M Powell Junction barred. Alternate routes: Patthe Bapurao Road, Javji Dadaji Marg, Opera House Junction and Maharshi Karve Road.

closures.road: Nathalal Parekh Marg (Bhai Bhandarkar Chowk to Sayyed Mohammed Jamadar Chowk)
closures.details: Listed as a prohibited road in Colaba Division; no-parking on immersion days. Heavy congestion expected in Cuffe Parade and Badhwar Park. The 6 Sep 2025 advisory also lists restrictions between Bhai Bhandarkar Chowk (Badhwar Park Junction) and Indu Clinic Junction.
closures.timeWindow: No parking 11 AM to 6 AM next day on immersion days

closures.road: Captain Prakash Pethe Marg (Zhulelal Mandir Junction to Sant Ghadge Maharaj Chowk)
closures.details: Listed as a prohibited road in Colaba Division; no-parking on immersion days.
closures.timeWindow: No parking 11 AM to 6 AM next day on immersion days

closures.road: Rambhau Salgaonkar Marg (Volga Chowk to Kamal Morarka Chowk)
closures.restriction: closed except emergency vehicles; no parking
closures.details: Emergency vehicles only; no-parking on immersion days (along with Pandey Road).
closures.timeWindow: No parking 11 AM to 6 AM next day on immersion days

closures.road: Netaji Subhashchandra Bose Road (Marine Drive)
closures.details: No parking from Air India Junction to Mafatlal Junction, both sides. Traffic from the north may be diverted from Islam Gymkhana to the Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj Coastal Road.

closures.road: Girgaon Chowpatty main gate
closures.details: Only vehicles carrying Ganpati idols permitted through the main gate. Heavy vehicles directed right (parking B1-B3), light vehicles left (A1-A3). Three designated exit gates after immersion. Citizens advised to use footpaths.

closures.road: Dr. Annie Besant Road, N.M. Joshi Marg, Bal Govindas Road, S.K. Bole Road
closures.details: Converted into one-way or temporarily closed during processions of Lalbaugcha Raja and other major mandals. Swatantraveer Savarkar Marg, Ranade Road, Tilak Road, M.B. Raut Road and Jambhekar Maharaj Marg will have regulated traffic movements.

closures.road: Dr. Annie Besant Road, R.G. Thadani Road, Swatantraveer Savarkar Marg, Ranade Road, Shivaji Park area roads
closures.details: Declared strict no-parking zones.

closures.road: Swatantraveer Savarkar Marg, Gokhale Road, Tilak Bridge, S.K. Bole Road, Bhawani Shankar Road
closures.details: Entry of heavy and goods vehicles prohibited on these roads.

closures.road: Juhu Tara Road, Devde Road and approach roads to Juhu Chowpatty
closures.restriction: closed except essential and resident vehicles
closures.details: Remain closed except for essential and resident vehicles. FPJ (27 Aug 2025) reports Devde Road, Juhu Tara Road and Oshiwara Nala completely closed during immersion processions.

closures.road: Juhu Road, Juhu Tara Road, Janardhan Mahtre Road, Gulmohar Road, Oshiwara areas, Poisar Junction, Marve Junction
closures.details: Strict no-parking regulations.

closures.road: Captain Gore Bridge (Santacruz), K.T. Son Marg (Kandivali), Abdul Hamid Road
closures.details: Operated as one-way during peak immersion timings.

closures.road: Marve Road (Malad), Bandarpakhadi Road (Kandivali), L.T. Road (Borivali)
closures.details: Diversions during immersion days. Heavy vehicles also banned on Madh-Marve Road (FPJ, 27 Aug 2025).

closures.road: Hemu Kalani Marg (Umarshi Bappa Jn to Basant Park Jn), Gidwani Marg (Golf Club to Chembur Naka), R.C. Road
closures.details: Closed for traffic during immersion processions; strict no-parking on V.N. Purav Marg, Hemu Kalani Marg, R.C. Marg, C.G. Gidwani Road. Segment endpoints from the 6 Sep 2025 FPJ advisory.

closures.road: R.C. Marg (Maravali Church to Chembur Naka)
closures.details: Heavy vehicles prohibited in both directions.

closures.road: Sion-Panvel Highway, Ghatkopar-Mankhurd Link Road, R.C. Marg, C.G. Gidwani Road
closures.details: Goods vehicle restrictions; Sion-Panvel Highway during peak hours. FPJ (27 Aug 2025) also lists LBS Road, JVLR, Hemu Kalani Marg, Gidwani Marg, Ghatla Village Road and Dr. CG Marg for heavy-vehicle bans.

closures.road: Shiv (Sion) Station Railway Bridge
closures.details: Closed to traffic.

closures.road: Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj Coastal Road
closures.details: Motorists advised to use the Coastal Road for north-south movement during the visarjan period.

facts.text: In 2025 the procession began from Lalbaug at noon on Saturday (6 September) and reached Girgaon Chowpatty around 8 AM on Sunday.

In 2025 the immersion was completed around 9 PM on Sunday, about 12 hours later than the typical 9 AM timing, after a high tide (4.42 metres predicted at 11:40 AM) and a technical snag while shifting the 18-foot idol onto the electrically operated raft.
The visarjan procession often stretches well past 24 hours.

In 2024 Lalbaugcha Raja entered Girgaon Chowpatty around 6 AM on Wednesday (18 September) after a procession that continued for 23 hours; immersion was done using a hydraulic mechanical raft despite heavy rain around 5 AM.
